intro: How many sides of you can you show?
description:
Could you get through school life without changing who you are?

We have all been too serious for our own good or struggled to say what we really mean. Everyone has moments when their personality gets in the way.

This is a four-choice game where you change your personality to face one school incident after another.

Each incident calls for a particular type. Use mind hacking to enter a classmate's thoughts and choose one of four options. Your four gauges shift between introversion and extraversion, sensing and intuition, thinking and feeling, and judging and perceiving. Reach the target zone with three gauges to transform successfully and solve the incident with that type's strengths.

It's easy to play.
・Read the incident
・Choose one of four options
・Watch the four gauges and aim for the target zone

Your survival meter drops with every choice. Reach zero and you're out. A successful transformation restores a large amount, while newly awakened types are recorded as you discover them.

There is no single best personality. Careful thinking can be perfect for one incident, while bold action is the answer to another. The real thrill is becoming the type you need most.

With 48 incidents and 320 sync questions appearing in different combinations, every playthrough can unfold differently. Awaken all 16 types to clear the game.

Take on one incident in a spare moment, or aim to complete all 16 transformations. Fancy trying a different side of yourself today?
